title: Pullman's roof joined under one rail; ivy off the corner windows
items: 1729 Prairie's mansard is now one roof: the north block, the entry, the 18th Street and rear sections run back into the house's roof instead of standing under their own, so the notch between the north block and the entry is gone
One rail of iron cresting runs round the whole deck, with a finial at each corner, as the Detroit photograph shows
The ivy at the south-west corner is cut back: it keeps clear of the ground-floor windows on both faces and stops at their heads
